Create a circle packing chart

Source: R/circle_packing.R
circle_packing.Rd

Draws a hierarchy as nested circles: every item is a circle whose area is proportional to its value, packed inside the circle of its group, itself packed inside the circle of its parent group, and so on. It shows the same part-to-whole structure as a treemap, with the groups easier to tell apart.

Usage

circle_packing(
  data,
  label,
  value = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  padding = 3,
  show_labels = TRUE,
  value_format = ",.0f",
  label_font_size = 11,
  zoom = TRUE,
  legend = TRUE,
  legend_font_size = 11,
  hover = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  title_font_size = 16,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bg_col = "white",
  text_col = "#333333",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per item.

label

The name of the column with the item names.

value

Optional. The name of a numeric column with the sizes. When NULL, every row counts as 1.

group

Optional. The names of one or more columns giving the groups, from the outermost to the innermost, such as c("continent", "region").

colors

Optional. Colours of the outermost groups: one per group or a named vector matched to the groups.

padding

The space between circles in pixels. Defaults to 3.

show_labels

Logical. Write the names of the circles that are large enough. Defaults to TRUE.

value_format

A d3 format for the values. Defaults to ",.0f".

label_font_size

The largest font size of the labels. Defaults to 11.

zoom

Logical. Click a group to zoom into it. Defaults to TRUE.

legend

Logical. Show a legend of the outermost groups. Defaults to TRUE.

legend_font_size

The font size of the legend. Defaults to 11.

hover

Logical. Show tooltips and highlight on hover. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Logical. Grow the circles when the chart is drawn. Defaults to TRUE.

title

Optional. The title of the chart.

title_font_size

The font size of the title. Defaults to 16.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

text_col

The colour of the text. Defaults to "#333333".

width, height

Optional. The size of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

Hover a circle to see its value and its share of its group. Click a group to zoom into it and click the background (or the zoomed group) to zoom back out (zoom). The circles grow level by level when the chart is drawn. Inside Shiny, clicking an item sets input$<id>_clicked to a list with label, value and path (its groups).

Examples

# World population in 2007, by continent and country
pop <- subset(gapminder::gapminder, year == 2007)
circle_packing(pop, label = "country", value = "pop", group = "continent",
               title = "World population, 2007")



# Car models, grouped by manufacturer, sized by the number of versions
circle_packing(ggplot2::mpg, label = "model", group = "manufacturer",
               legend = FALSE)



# Two levels of groups
sales <- data.frame(
  region = rep(c("North", "South"), each = 6),
  category = rep(rep(c("Furniture", "Office", "Tech"), each = 2), 2),
  product = c("Chairs", "Tables", "Paper", "Pens", "Phones", "Laptops",
              "Chairs", "Tables", "Paper", "Pens", "Phones", "Laptops"),
  revenue = c(120, 90, 40, 25, 210, 260, 80, 110, 55, 30, 160, 190)
)
circle_packing(sales, label = "product", value = "revenue",
               group = c("region", "category"), value_format = "$,.0f")
